data.name: Champion's Weapon Mastery
data.description: When a daring champion threatens a critical hit with a light or onehanded piercing melee weapon, that critical is automatically confirmed. Furthermore, the critical modifier of those weapons increases by 1 (x2 becomes x3, for example).
